title: 773. Sliding Puzzle

examples.explanation: One slide of 5 finishes the board.
Five swaps along a shortest path.

hints: Flatten the board to a 6-character string and precompute where the empty slot can move (neighbors in the 2x3 layout).
Run breadth-first search from the start string to 123450, tracking visited states and distance.
Return the distance when the target is dequeued, or -1 when the queue empties.
